title: The Zion Builder WordPress plugin through 3.6.17 does not sanitize uploaded SVG files or validate their contents…
description: The Zion Builder WordPress plugin versions through 3.6.17 allow authenticated users with Author role or higher to upload SVG files that are not sanitized or validated. These SVG files can contain malicious JavaScript, which executes in the browser of anyone who views the file, leading to potential cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.
